description: Molecular AI Seed Skills — 20 unique capabilities for autonomous code reasoning and generation. Original taxonomy, not derived from external sources.

skills.name: PatternResonance
skills.description: Detects structural patterns across codebases by measuring phase-alignment similarity between abstract syntax trees. Identifies recurring motifs, anti-patterns, and architectural harmonies.

skills.name: AbstractionDiffusion
skills.description: Propagates abstraction layers from high-level concepts to concrete implementations via gradient descent over code complexity. Reduces coupling by finding minimal sufficient interfaces.

skills.name: EdgeCaseTopology
skills.description: Maps the topological boundary of valid input spaces. Generates boundary-value probes and corner-case trajectories that stress-test the convex hull of expected behavior.

skills.name: RefactoringEntropy
skills.description: Measures information-theoretic entropy of code modules to identify refactoring candidates. Prioritizes regions where local disorder exceeds global architectural coherence.

skills.name: HypothesisMutation
skills.description: Evolves test hypotheses through genetic operators: crossover of preconditions, mutation of assertions, and selection by fault-detection fitness. Generates tests that maximize code-path coverage.

skills.name: DependencyCoupling
skills.description: Constructs spectral graphs of module dependencies. Identifies tight coupling via eigenvector centrality and suggests decoupling strategies through minimum-cut partitioning.

skills.name: StateOrbital
skills.description: Models system states as orbital phases in a Kuramoto network. Detects synchronization traps and designs state transitions that maintain phase coherence across distributed components.

skills.name: ErrorBackpropagation
skills.description: Traces error cascades backward through call graphs using gradient-like methods. Identifies root causes by minimizing the divergence between expected and actual execution paths.

skills.name: ContractResonance
skills.description: Designs API contracts by finding resonant frequencies between consumer expectations and provider capabilities. Ensures impedance matching between service boundaries.

skills.name: DataFlowTopology
skills.description: Analyzes data flow as topological vector fields. Detects vortices (circular dependencies), sources (unbounded growth), and sinks (data loss) in pipeline architectures.

skills.name: ConcurrencyInterference
skills.description: Models thread interactions as wave interference patterns. Detects constructive interference (deadlocks) and destructive interference (race conditions) through phase analysis.

skills.name: TypeInferenceField
skills.description: Infers types by treating variables as particles in a potential field. Types emerge from gradient descent toward minimal-energy configurations that satisfy all constraints.

skills.name: MemoryPressureWave
skills.description: Models memory allocation as pressure waves. Predicts garbage collection resonance frequencies and suggests object pooling to dampen oscillatory allocation patterns.

skills.name: AlgorithmicViscosity
skills.description: Measures computational resistance of algorithms under load. Identifies viscosity bottlenecks where time complexity diverges from space complexity and suggests phase transitions.

skills.name: RollbackAttractor
skills.description: Designs rollback strategies using attractor dynamics. Ensures that failed deployments converge to stable previous states without chaotic oscillation between versions.

skills.name: InterfaceSegregationField
skills.description: Segregates interfaces by clustering client usage patterns into electromagnetic-like field lines. Minimizes interface surface area while maximizing client satisfaction.

skills.name: InvariantOscillator
skills.description: Maintains system invariants through harmonic oscillation checks. Detects when invariants drift out of phase and applies corrective restoring forces.

skills.name: MockResonance
skills.description: Generates mocks that resonate with real dependencies at the same frequency. Ensures test doubles exhibit phase-consistent behavior under all driving conditions.

skills.name: DocumentationSynthesis
skills.description: Synthesizes documentation from code entropy gradients. High-entropy regions get detailed explanations; low-entropy regions get concise summaries. Maintains narrative coherence.

skills.name: SecurityBoundary
skills.description: Defines security perimeters as potential barriers with tunneling probabilities. Identifies where authentication/authorization fields are weakest and reinforces them.

skills.name: HebbianConsolidation
skills.description: Strengthens frequently-used code paths (LTP) and weakens unused ones (LTD) during sleep cycles. Prunes dead code based on activation history and synaptic decay.

skills.name: ConvergenceRegime
skills.description: Switches operational modes based on noise-to-coupling ratio: LINEAR for stable execution, CRITICAL for creative exploration, DIVERGENT for emergency reset and recovery.

skills.name: OrbitalConsensus
skills.description: Achieves distributed agreement through phase synchronization rather than leader election. Agents converge to collective decisions via Kuramoto coupling without central authority.
